title: Sungrass
wikitext:
'''Sungrass''' is an [[Herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (230).

==Source==
Sungrass can be found most frequently in [[Eastern Plaguelands]], [[Thousand Needles]], and [[Badlands]]. It has also been seen in [[Burning Steppes]], [[Un'Goro Crater]], and [[Tanaris]]. Sungrass is most commonly found in open areas.
